messages.content_text:
@Premium i know u hate me for pinging u all the time but please take a look at what i posted regarding the 30 day challenge

Consider it the part 2 of ⁠random-thoughts-for-you 

I really want to show u that if u setup a framework that u like, stick to it and put in enough reps you'll start figuring trading out.

When i first started building a framework to trade with i experimented a lot with concepts and that turned out to be the main thing holding me back.

I would do good with stuff for a while but when i saw negative results i thought "maybe this isnt for me after all let me see if theres another strat that will help"

Losing sucks, i know but when i first decided to stick to a framework the first months if not the first year was really hard but i kept trading the same way no matter what.

Wether u like it or not trading is a job, and if u keep gambling or crashing out ur basically making the work u put in that week/weeks, month/months or even year building an account to be in vain and all those hours u put in were all for nothing except "experience".

"Experience" is not bad don't get me wrong but most of u take that "experience" reflect on it and go "yeah i gotta follow rules" for a couple days and crash out again in a short period of time.

U cant crash out, u cant afford to sabotage yourself.

U gotta lock in 100% or youll get left behind.
